title: Lemon Chicken Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful dish made with crispy chicken, served on top of a bed of greens, and a squeeze of fresh lemon.

ingredients.name: syrian feta cheese (optional)
ingredients.notes: optional for those who can consume dairy

instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemony olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the salad by washing and drying the crisp lettuce.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
To assemble the bowl, place a scoop of the crisp lettuce on a plate, top with sliced chicken, and sprinkle with syrian feta cheese if desired.
